card.text: Explore Sibylla in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Convex light-curve reconstruction. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: DAMIT 6009 shape model
shape.summary: Convex light-curve reconstruction with approximate thermal size: 146.48 km (catalog ±1.74 km; additional shape and thermal-model uncertainty). Thermal size is used as a volume-scale approximation. The grid marks unavailable imagery.

elevation.title: DAMIT 6009 radial height
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 73.24 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
